about: The only cron job names cron.run may carry (spec 4.1 job_name). Exactly the names the installer creates (install/install_index.ts DIGEST_CRON_SPECS); install/tests/av_events_state.test.ts fails if the two drift. Any other job's name is null: a participant can have the agent schedule anything, and cron.run is kept without research consent (spec 2.2).
